component.name: Lithotheque Server
component.summary: Personal geological field server: QR code sync, interactive map, stereonet, and GIS exports

description.p: Lithotheque Server (Personal Edition) is a local desktop companion for geological field data collected with the Lithotheque mobile app.

ul.li: Direct 1-device pairing via QR code over LAN or WireGuard
Interactive map with official ICS stratigraphy colors, vector shapes, and photo gallery
Interactive stereonet (poles, planes, Fisher mean, rose diagram, HD PNG export)
Dynamic GIS exports: CSV, GeoJSON, GPX, KML, OGC GeoPackage (.gpkg), and ZIP
100% offline local SQLite storage in 43 languages

description.p: Initial Personal Edition release (v3.3.4) with 14-day free trial and Creem license validation.
